A passing failure test means the deliberately bad input was detected, not that an error was ignored.

First failure: **none observed**; no repair event was invented. ## Why limitations change the action

Terminal value is {{terminal_share}} of EV. WACC +1pp reduces base value to ${{changed_value}}, still below $218.36, so the action stays WATCH / DEFER. The combined demand/financing downside changes the action to DO NOT INITIATE. These are different tests: an unchanged threshold decision is explained, while the risk regime can reverse the recommendation.

## Contamination catalog and financial limits

- **Base-year normalization:** FY26 net H20 charge $4,320m; normalized EBIT $134,707m and gross margin 73.07%. It has already rolled out of the LTM base, so it is not added again.
- **Operating boundary:** Investment gains and interest income are excluded from operating FCFF; equity holdings are not cash or working capital. All signed operating cash flows remain in the DCF.
- **Share/price basis:** Annual weighted diluted shares are not exact current shares; the 24,242m diluted proxy is explicit. Old intraday $224.35 differs from September 10 close $218.36.
- **Owner cost/acquisitions:** SBC and retention retain their cost. Pending acquisition cash is included without operating upside; provisional goodwill is not a final GAAP allocation.
- **Forecast limits:** Cash interpolation, leases, deferred tax and refinancing are simplified; terminal returns and recoveries are assumptions. Guarantee bridge losses are not booked liabilities; actual calls require funded forecasts.
